demo_extraction.scope_summary: Scan and index 400,000 land revenue records with data entry and quality control. Build a records search web application for revenue offices. Run the scanning operation on site at two district record rooms.

eligibility.requirement: Valid NTN and active ATL status
eligibility.source_quote: The bidder must hold a valid National Tax Number (NTN) and appear on the FBR Active Taxpayers List (ATL).

eligibility.requirement: Minimum annual turnover of PKR 30 million during the last financial year.
eligibility.source_quote: Minimum annual turnover of PKR 30 million during the last financial year.

eligibility.requirement: Punjab office, or undertaking to open one
eligibility.source_quote: The bidder must have an office in Punjab, or submit an undertaking to establish one within 30 days of contract award.
The bidder should have digitized at least one million physical records in past assignments.
Experience with land revenue systems will be an added advantage.
Affidavit on stamp paper that the bidder has not been blacklisted by any government body.
Bid security in the form of a pay order or bank guarantee shall accompany the financial bid.
